When prospective clients reach out with questions regarding service scope, pricing baselines, or calendar availability, they frequently encounter two friction points: unstaffed phone lines during peak hours, and passive forms with 12-to-24-hour response latencies. In high-intent service categories, research shows that answering within the first five minutes increases lead qualification likelihood by over twenty times.
